summary: recordPrices returns early when EDEKA_NO_LOCAL_DATA=1, and price history neither creates nor opens a store that does not exist yet while the switch is on, so no search, offers, deals or basket call writes product prices to disk after the operator opts out.
reason: The hand-written price recorder sits outside the generated data-source and cache gates that the env switch drives, so without its own guard every product search kept writing names and prices to the local SQLite store.
validated_outcome: TestRecordPricesHonoursNoLocalData and TestPriceHistoryNoLocalDataCreatesNoStore fail without the guards; TestRecordPricesWritesByDefault is the control.
